title: MixEval: Deriving Wisdom of the Crowd from LLM Benchmark Mixtures

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing benchmark query distributions by embedding them into a 2-D space and calculating their cluster distance to a large corpus of real-world web queries to detect distribution skew and lack of comprehensiveness.

Mitigating inherent LLM-as-judge preference biases (such as verbosity bias, position bias, and self-enhancement bias) by utilizing an objective, ground-truth-based benchmark matching and scoring mechanism.
Addressing benchmark data contamination and model overfitting by dynamically updating the benchmark pool with new web queries and measuring score stability and unique sample ratios across versions.
